status: DRAFT v2 for AK review, 30 Oct 2026. Not voiced.
format: F11 Claim Check (Story Engine §3), with an F5 own-words layer in chapter 3

beats.move: F11-1 Headline as a scene · M1 hook
beats.say: Ninety percent. You will often read that one town in Tamil Nadu, Tiruppur, makes ninety percent of India's knitwear.
beats.caption: Tiruppur = *90%* of India's knitwear? · CLAIM
beats.visual: 100-dot grid of India's knitwear; 90 dots light up; red CLAIM stamp (popular claim, myths M1)
beats.myth: M1 (C081 CONTRADICTED; told only as the claim being checked)

beats.say: Before we check it, make your own guess. Ninety? More? Less? Hold that number.
beats.caption: Your guess?
beats.visual: the 90 dots pulse; a blank guess box; 1 s hold

beats.say: We read every share we could find in print, and four export figures for one year.
beats.caption: Every share · *four* figures · one year
beats.visual: four empty bars slide in, unlabelled

beats.say: Three of those four come from the same association. And they do not agree.
beats.caption: Same association · *don't agree*
beats.visual: three of the four bars get the same TEA tag; a question mark

beats.say: First, where is it? Tiruppur sits in western Tamil Nadu, about forty three kilometres from Coimbatore in a straight line.
beats.caption: Coimbatore → Tiruppur · ~43 km (straight line)
beats.visual: India outline zooms to Tamil Nadu; a straight dashed line, Coimbatore to Tiruppur

beats.say: And it is inland. The nearest port city, Kochi, is about one hundred and seventy kilometres away.
beats.caption: Nearest port city: Kochi · ~170 km
beats.visual: straight line west to Kochi; coastline highlighted

beats.say: No sea. No port. Keep that in mind.
beats.caption: No sea · no port
beats.visual: the town dot alone on the map

beats.say: Tiruppur became its own district only in two thousand nine, carved out of Coimbatore and Erode.
beats.caption: District since 2009
beats.visual: district outline split off two neighbours (illustrative outline)

beats.say: At the twenty eleven census, the district had nearly twenty five lakh people.
beats.caption: ~24.8 lakh people · Census 2011
beats.visual: dot-people fill the district

beats.say: For decades, its workshops made one simple thing: cotton vests and briefs, for Indian buyers.
beats.caption: Vests and briefs · local market
beats.visual: a hand-cranked knitting machine; a white banian

beats.say: So when did the first knitting unit open? It depends on whom you ask.
beats.caption: First unit: when?
beats.visual: three empty date cards

beats.say: Nineteen twenty five, says the exporters' association. Nineteen thirty five, says the Textile Commissioner. Nineteen thirty seven, says a UNIDO study.
beats.caption: 1925 TEA · 1935 Textile Commr · 1937 UNIDO
beats.visual: the three cards flip one by one, each with its source chip; no faces

beats.say: Remember that. In Tiruppur, even the first date comes in three versions.
beats.caption: One town · *three* dates
beats.visual: the three cards stack

beats.say: Until about nineteen eighty, it stayed a cottage industry, selling at home.
beats.caption: Cottage industry · until ~1980
beats.visual: small home workshops on a street

beats.say: Then exports began, mostly through agents in Bombay and Delhi.
beats.caption: Exports from 1980 · via Bombay, Delhi
beats.visual: arrows from Tiruppur to Bombay and Delhi, then out to sea

beats.say: Until nineteen eighty five, the only thing it exported was the T-shirt.
beats.caption: Only export till 1985: *T-shirt*
beats.visual: one white T-shirt on a hanger

beats.say: Here is a table the exporters kept. In nineteen eighty six, direct exports were about thirty seven crore rupees.
beats.caption: 1986 · ₹37.48 cr · direct
beats.visual: a typed 1994 table; one row lights up; source chip TEA table via MIDS

beats.say: By nineteen ninety three, about one thousand two hundred crore.
beats.caption: 1993 · ₹1,197.5 cr · direct
beats.visual: the bar shoots up

beats.say: That is about thirty two times as much, in seven years.
beats.caption: ~32× in 7 years (calculated)
beats.visual: the 1986 bar copied 32 times beside the 1993 bar

beats.say: Now guess. Did the town make thirty two times as many pieces?
beats.caption: 32× the pieces?
beats.visual: a pile of T-shirts with a question mark; 1 s hold

beats.say: No. Pieces grew only about six and a half times.
beats.caption: Pieces: ~6.45× (calculated)
beats.visual: the T-shirt pile grows far less than the money bar

beats.say: So each piece earned more. In nineteen eighty six, about one rupee thirty.
beats.caption: 1986 · ₹1.30 a piece
beats.visual: one T-shirt with a price tag

beats.say: By nineteen ninety three, about six rupees forty, for each piece.
beats.caption: 1993 · ₹6.43 a piece (calculated)
beats.visual: the price tag swells

beats.say: So the jump was not just more T-shirts. It was more money in each one.
beats.caption: More money *per piece*
beats.visual: two tags side by side

beats.say: But notice one word in that table. Direct. Direct exports. That word will matter.
beats.caption: *Direct* exports
beats.visual: the word DIRECT circled on the old table

beats.say: Why so many small firms? Partly the law. In the early nineteen sixties, cotton hosiery knitting was reserved for small units.
beats.caption: Early 1960s · reserved for small units
beats.visual: a rule-book stamp: SMALL UNITS ONLY

beats.say: So anyone with more money split the work into two or three units.
beats.caption: One firm → 2–3 units
beats.visual: one factory splits into three

beats.say: One study put it plainly: the easiest method adopted was to multiply the number of units.
beats.caption: "multiply the number of units" · MIDS
beats.visual: the three units multiply across the map

beats.say: In nineteen eighty four, a business magazine wrote that there were unlikely to be more than five hundred families in the business.
beats.caption: ≤500 families? · Business India, 1984
beats.visual: 500 small house icons

beats.say: Yet notes from nineteen ninety four and two thousand seven each count about two thousand five hundred knitting units.
beats.caption: ~2,500 knitting units · 1994, 2007
beats.visual: the 500 houses become 2,500 workshop dots

beats.say: And many owners began on the floor. One study says almost all the big names were once workers themselves.
beats.caption: Worker → owner · MIDS
beats.visual: a worker's apron becomes an owner's ledger (no faces, no community colours)

beats.say: The town also built what it lacked. In nineteen ninety four, the exporters asked for a container terminal and a sewage plant, and got no reply.
beats.caption: 1994 · asked · *no reply*
beats.visual: a letter with no answer; clock ticks

beats.say: So they built their own export estate, one hundred and fifty seven units, in ten months, with their own money.
beats.caption: 157 units · 10 months · self-financed
beats.visual: an estate assembles block by block

beats.say: Water came later: a pipeline carries Cauvery water about fifty three and a half kilometres, from the treatment plant to a reservoir at Tiruppur.
beats.caption: ~53.5 km pipeline · route illustrative
beats.visual: a line drawn only between named places; label: route illustrative

beats.say: And the exporters' association is one of the water company's promoters.
beats.caption: TEA · a promoter of the water company
beats.visual: TEA badge joins TWIC and IL&FS badges

beats.say: Thousands of small units, one exporters' association. Now, back to the claim.
beats.caption: Small units · one association
beats.visual: pull back to the 100-dot grid from the open

beats.say: Ninety percent of India's knitwear? We found five different shares in print. None of them is ninety.
beats.caption: 5 shares in print · none is 90%
beats.visual: five empty rungs of a ladder

beats.say: Nineteen ninety four. The exporters' own note says nearly eighty five percent of India's cotton knitwear exports.
beats.caption: 1994 · ~85% · cotton knitwear · TEA
beats.visual: rung 1 fills

beats.say: But that counted indirect exports too, the ones that left through Bombay and Delhi. Remember the word direct?
beats.caption: Includes *indirect*
beats.visual: the circled DIRECT from r12 flips to INDIRECT

beats.say: Around two thousand seven, a Textile Commissioner's note says about seventy five percent.
beats.caption: c.2007 · ~75% · Textile Commr
beats.visual: rung 2 fills

beats.say: For twenty twenty four twenty five, the association's own table gives sixty eight point six five percent.
beats.caption: FY25 · 68.65% · TEA table
beats.visual: rung 3 fills

beats.say: Its releases in mid twenty twenty six say nearly sixty.
beats.caption: Jun–Jul 2026 · ~60% · TEA releases
beats.visual: rung 4 fills

beats.say: And in September twenty twenty six, the association secretary's report says fifty four point seven four percent.
beats.caption: Sep 2026 · 54.74% · TEA Secretary
beats.visual: rung 5 fills; the 90 lit dots fall to 55

beats.say: That is still more than half. About eleven of every twenty rupees of India's knitwear exports.
beats.caption: ≈ 11 of every ₹20
beats.visual: 20 coins, 11 lit

beats.say: Widen the lens to all garments, knitted and woven, and a twenty sixteen ministry release put Tiruppur at twenty two percent.
beats.caption: All garments · 22% · Textiles Ministry, 2016
beats.visual: a bigger grid: knitted plus woven; 22 dots lit

beats.say: So the share moves, because each source counts something different. More than half of India's knitwear. Not ninety.
beats.caption: More than half · *not 90*
beats.visual: ladder with all five rungs; CLAIM stamp cracks

beats.say: Now the money. How much did Tiruppur export in twenty twenty five twenty six?
beats.caption: FY 2025-26 · how much?
beats.visual: the four empty bars from the open return

beats.say: Start with the government. The Ministry of Textiles lists Tiruppur first among five hundred and forty eight exporting districts.
beats.caption: 1st of 548 exporting districts · MoT
beats.visual: a long list of districts; Tiruppur's row at the top

beats.say: Its figure: thirty eight thousand six hundred and seventy seven crore rupees.
beats.caption: ₹38,677 cr · DGCIS (provisional)
beats.visual: bar 1 fills, in government blue

beats.say: That counts textiles and ready-made garments, with handicrafts included. And it is provisional.
beats.caption: Textiles + garments + handicrafts
beats.visual: bar 1 label: what it counts

beats.say: That is about one hundred and six crore rupees for every day of the year.
beats.caption: ≈ ₹106 cr a day (calculated)
beats.visual: a calendar page flips; ₹106 cr per page

beats.say: Now the exporters' association. In June, reports quoting it said forty two thousand five hundred and forty four crore.
beats.caption: ₹42,544 cr · TEA, via press (Jun 2026)
beats.visual: bar 2 fills, in TEA orange

beats.say: Down about five percent on the year before.
beats.visual: a small red arrow

beats.say: Weeks later, the same association announced about forty six thousand crore.
beats.caption: ~₹46,000 cr · TEA (Jun–Jul 2026)
beats.visual: bar 3 fills, also TEA orange

beats.say: Up about three percent. And called a record.
beats.caption: ↑ ~3% · "record"
beats.visual: a small green arrow; the word record

beats.say: Same association. Same year. One figure is a fall. The other is a record.
beats.caption: Same year · a *fall* and a *record*
beats.visual: bars 2 and 3 side by side, red arrow against green; music rises

beats.say: Then, in September, the secretary's report: thirty six thousand eight hundred and ninety one crore, for knitwear.
beats.caption: ₹36,891 cr · knitwear · TEA Secretary
beats.visual: bar 4 fills, TEA orange

beats.say: Up about two point four percent. Work that backwards, and the year before was about thirty six thousand crore.
beats.caption: +2.40% → base ≈ ₹36,000 cr (calculated)
beats.visual: a ledger sum runs backwards

beats.say: Not the forty four thousand seven hundred and forty seven crore the other reports used. A different series altogether.
beats.caption: FY25 base in other reports: ₹44,747 cr
beats.visual: two base bars that do not match

beats.say: We found no page that explains the gap.
beats.caption: Reason for the gap: not stated
beats.visual: a blank explanation card

beats.say: Highest to lowest, the association's figures sit about nine thousand crore apart. Nearly a quarter of the government's whole number.
beats.caption: Gap ≈ ₹9,100 cr ≈ ¼ of ₹38,677 cr (calculated)
beats.visual: the gap cut out and laid against bar 1

beats.say: Four numbers for one year. Remember the three dates for the first factory? Same town, same habit of counting differently.
beats.caption: 4 figures · 1 year · like the *3 dates*
beats.visual: the three date cards slide in beside the bars

beats.say: Whatever the count, the money comes from abroad. So where does India's knitwear go?
beats.caption: Where does it go?
beats.visual: globe turns

beats.say: In twenty twenty five, the United States took about thirty two percent of India's knitted clothing exports.
beats.caption: USA · 32.3% · India's HS 61, 2025
beats.visual: arc from India to the US

beats.say: The twenty seven EU countries took about thirty percent.
beats.caption: EU-27 · 30.4% · India's HS 61
beats.visual: arc to Europe

beats.say: The UK, about nine percent.
beats.caption: UK · 8.7% · India's HS 61
beats.visual: arc to the UK

beats.say: These are India's figures, not Tiruppur's own.
beats.caption: India's figures, not Tiruppur's
beats.visual: the arcs start from India, not from the town

beats.say: In August twenty twenty five, US duties on Indian goods added up to fifty percent.
beats.caption: Aug 2025 · 25% + 25% = 50%
beats.visual: a stacked tariff bar

beats.say: By February twenty twenty six, those extra duties had been ended.
beats.caption: Feb 2026 · ended
beats.visual: the stack dissolves

beats.say: Since the twenty fourth of July twenty twenty six, a ten percent US duty applies, on top of the normal one.
beats.caption: From 24 Jul 2026 · +10% (Section 301)
beats.visual: a thin 10% bar

beats.say: Knitted T-shirts are not exempt.
beats.caption: T-shirts: not exempt
beats.visual: the white T-shirt from r03 gets the 10% tag

beats.say: Britain's trade deal with India has been in force since the fifteenth of July twenty twenty six.
beats.caption: UK deal · in force 15 Jul 2026
beats.visual: UK arc turns green

beats.say: The EU deal is concluded, but not yet in force.
beats.caption: EU deal · concluded, not in force
beats.visual: EU arc dotted

beats.say: So, the verdict on the headline. Ninety percent? Not supported. The latest share in print is about fifty five.
beats.caption: 90%? *Not supported* · latest: 54.74%
beats.visual: stamp lands: CONTRADICTED

beats.say: Who captures the export money? First, the exporters: an association of one thousand five hundred and twenty two members by September twenty twenty six.
beats.caption: TEA · 1,522 members (Sep 2026)
beats.visual: member dots fill the town

beats.say: Workers' pay is set for the whole town in one deal: thirty three percent over four years, signed in March twenty twenty six.
beats.caption: Wage pact · 33% over 4 years · Mar 2026
beats.visual: one contract signed by many associations and unions

beats.say: The dyers carried the clean-water bill: about one thousand crore rupees for eighteen treatment plants, by twenty sixteen.
beats.caption: ~₹1,013 cr · 18 plants · by 2016
beats.visual: dyeing vats; a bill

beats.say: And their own association says more than a lakh tonnes of waste salt sit in sheds, with no proper disposal method so far.
beats.caption: >1 lakh tonnes of salt · Dyers Assn
beats.visual: white salt heaps in sheds

beats.say: What protects the town's position? Not the sea; it has none. It is the cluster: thousands of small units, and the estate and water they organised themselves.
beats.caption: Moat: the cluster, not the coast
beats.visual: map: the town dot, the estate, the pipeline line

beats.say: What protects the margin? The early lesson from the table: more money per piece, not just more pieces.
beats.caption: Margin: value *per piece*
beats.visual: the two price tags from r09–r10 return

beats.say: And the pressure is plain: a ten percent US duty on Indian T-shirts, while the British deal is open.
beats.caption: US +10% · UK deal open
beats.visual: T-shirt with 10% tag; green UK arc

beats.say: The association's target is one lakh crore rupees of exports by twenty thirty.
beats.caption: Target: ₹1 lakh cr by 2030 · TEA
beats.visual: a target line far above the bars

beats.say: From forty six thousand crore, that needs about seventeen to twenty one percent growth a year. Faster than any of its three figures for twenty twenty five twenty six.
beats.caption: Needs ~17–21% a year (calculated)
beats.visual: growth line climbs; FY26 arrows (−4.9%, +3%, +2.4%) sit far below

beats.say: Remember your guess? Ninety? The latest figure in print is a little over half.
beats.caption: Your guess · *54.74%*
beats.visual: the 100-dot grid from the open; 55 dots lit

beats.say: And one town still has three dates for its first unit, and three numbers for one year.
beats.caption: 3 dates · 3 numbers
beats.visual: date cards and TEA bars side by side

beats.say: So the next time you hear a number about a town, ask one thing first. Whose count is it?
beats.caption: Whose count is it?
beats.visual: the four bars, each with its source chip; hold
